question: Should OpenClaw accept `sessions.diagnose`, `openclaw sessions diagnose`, and the proposed diagnosis result vocabulary as supported core operator/client API in this PR?
rationale: The code path has no concrete contributor-facing defect in this review, but adding a durable Gateway/CLI/protocol surface is a product/API commitment that automation should not approve by itself.

options.title: Accept The Diagnosis API
options.body: Land the read-only Gateway RPC, CLI command, Swift model, docs, and result vocabulary as the canonical core operator diagnosis surface.

options.title: Narrow Before Merge
options.body: Trim fields, finding codes, or CLI behavior now if maintainers want less long-term compatibility surface.

options.title: Pause Direction
options.body: Pause or close this PR and continue direction on the linked feature issue if core should not own this API yet.

recommendation.title: Accept The Diagnosis API
recommendation.body: Land the read-only Gateway RPC, CLI command, Swift model, docs, and result vocabulary as the canonical core operator diagnosis surface.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest sampled history across adjacent public session Gateway/protocol surfaces and is the best available routing candidate for the API acceptance choice.
